lines.text: Hi, I'm here for a class at Cedar Workshop.
lines.speaker: Jia

lines.text: Is it the cooking class or the camera class?
lines.speaker: Seth

lines.text: The camera class. It starts in fifteen minutes.
lines.speaker: Jia

lines.text: That's at the west building. Take the free shuttle from here.
lines.speaker: Seth

lines.text: How long does the shuttle take?
lines.speaker: Jia

lines.text: It takes five minutes. Get off at the second stop.
lines.speaker: Seth

lines.text: Do I go in through the blue door by the bike racks?
lines.speaker: Jia

lines.text: Use the glass door. The blue door is closed today.
lines.speaker: Seth
